newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Georgia Gulf cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Georgia Gulf cut.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Paul T. Leming said he cut his rating on Georgia Gulf Corp to hold from buy.
-- He said he cut his fourth quarter 1996 earnings per share estimate to $0.45 from $0.65, his 1996 full year EPS view to $1.95 from $2.15 and his 1997 EPS estimate to $2.50 from $4.
-- "We believe the chances of there being a sharp acceleration in earnings over the next several quarters have dwindled close to zero," Leming said in a research note.
